cash_ledger_join: Design 2.1:75, 3:100 step 11 and 13:376. Step 11 appends the fee cash event for each chosen fill and, on an exit, the gross realized PnL in the same fill sequence, so the in-window ledger is FEE(F0) -0.04725, GROSS(F0) +5, FEE(F1) -0.049499999999999995, GROSS(F1) +10. Each fee_events row equals its joined cash row. The pre-window entry fill at 2000-01-01T00:11:00Z charged its own ENTRY fee of 0.09 (fee_notional 100 * 2 * 1), so equity_curve.first = 1000 - 0.09 = 999.91 and equity_curve.last = 999.91 - 0.04725 + 5 - 0.049499999999999995 + 10 = 1014.81325. net_trade_pnl is lifecycle-scoped (design 13:378) and therefore includes the pre-window entry fee. Re-derived under design 23.2:1057-1064, which now fixes the window-scoped reading V15-D02 flagged as unfixed; the design labels that scope an AMENDMENT-CHOICE (:1066-1072). V15-D02 CLOSED, value unchanged.

Section 3 step 2 :91 records which stop and targets touched before any winner is chosen, and the independence row :1046 states that sections 3, 10 and 12 separate stop evaluation from same-bar policy resolution, so the two are distinct closed reasons on a DEF-P012-06 row. The prior kernel name SOLE_EXIT_CLASS maps to PROTECTIVE_STOP_EVALUATED in that same row. Order: step 2 precedes step 3, so the stop evaluation is sequence 1 and the policy resolution sequence 2. NO ECONOMIC VALUE MOVED: stop_price 90 restates a stated scenario input and no fill, fee, PnL or equity node is touched.
